metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the household-finance-brokerage-platform domain, modeled on Peasy, hypotheek.winkel, Verzekeringen.be and Aanbieders.be: the consumer comparison platform with mortgage simulators, feasibility certificate, upload-your-proposal, insurance, energy and telecom comparison, budget barometer and appointment, callback and content surfaces; the mortgage brokerage workbench with the daily conditions of 25 banks, multi-bank comparison, advice record, credit file, bank submission, closing and refinancing; the insurance, energy and telecom brokerage with quote and bind, switch execution, cancellation and customer care; the household relationship with contract vault, renewal monitoring and customer 360; network and partner operations with lead routing, franchise management, dashboards, academy, partner catalogue, commissions and partner portal; and the platform foundation of identity, compliance, integration gateway and analytics.

rootGroups.name: Consumer Comparison Platform
rootGroups.description: The public front door of peasy.be, hypotheekwinkel.be, verzekeringen.be/assurances.be and aanbieders.be/mesfournisseurs.be in Dutch and French: the mortgage simulators (how much can I borrow, monthly repayment, feasibility check and certificate, notary costs and financial plan), the upload-your-proposal intake, the insurance, energy and telecom comparison modules, the budget barometer that benchmarks a household against Belgian averages, and the appointment, callback, chat and content surfaces that turn a comparison into a conversation with one of the 150+ experts in about 70 offices or the customer-care centres in Hasselt and Oujda.

bricks.name: Borrowing Capacity and Monthly Repayment Simulator
bricks.description: The simulators that start most first-time buyer journeys on hypotheekwinkel.be and peasy.be: how much can I borrow, what will my monthly repayment be, at which indicative rate and over which duration, with an amortisation table. Inputs are income, savings, existing loans and the project type (first home, next home, second home, new build, renovation, self-employed). Results use indicative conditions derived from the daily bank rate feed rather than a single bank's tariff, and every simulation can be saved, e-mailed or turned into a lead for the nearest office, which is why simulation volume and simulation-to-appointment conversion are watched daily.

bricks.name: Feasibility Check and Certificate
bricks.description: The haalbaarheidscertificaat: a feasibility check that compares the buyer's salary and savings against the acceptance rules of the 25 banks, accounts for the Flemish renovation obligation of low-EPC homes and the notary and registration costs, and issues a signed certificate the buyer shows to sellers and estate agents to prove borrowing capacity. It is a differentiator of hypotheek.winkel against competing brokers and a strong lead magnet, so the brick tracks issuance rate, certificate-to-appointment conversion and how often a certified budget later matches the approved loan.

bricks.name: Notary Costs and Financial Plan Calculator

bricks.name: Upload-Your-Proposal Intake
bricks.description: The "upload je voorstel" service on peasy.be and hypotheekwinkel.be: a household uploads the mortgage or insurance proposal it received from its own bank or elsewhere and gets a free expert verdict on whether it can be beaten. The intake captures the document, classifies it (mortgage, refinancing, car, fire, outstanding-balance), extracts the key conditions and creates a lead with a review case for an expert or advisor. Turnaround of the review is a north-star metric for refinancers, so the brick tracks time-to-verdict and how many reviews turn into a comparison.

bricks.name: Insurance Comparison Module
bricks.description: The Verzekeringen.be / Assurances.be comparison for car, fire and contents, funeral, outstanding-balance and the other covers listed on the site, across the 11 insurers whose products Peasy brokers. A household answers a short questionnaire (vehicle, home, age, health questions for outstanding-balance cover), sees premiums and cover differences side by side and picks an offer to be quoted and bound by an advisor. The module normalises very different insurer product structures into one comparison and records every comparison request so customer care can pick it up in one contact.

bricks.name: Budget Barometer
bricks.description: The peasy.be budgetbarometer: a household enters or confirms what it pays for its mortgage, insurance, energy, internet, TV and mobile and sees each line against the Belgian average for a comparable household, with the total overpayment and the biggest saving opportunities first. Every line links straight into the matching comparison module, and for a household with a customer account the barometer is pre-filled from the contract vault. It is the entry point of the household-relationship strategy: one view that turns a single mortgage customer into a family that lets Peasy watch all its fixed costs.

bricks.name: Appointment Booking and Office Locator
bricks.description: Find the nearest of about 70 hypotheek.winkel offices or choose a video call, pick a slot in the expert's agenda, and get a confirmation with what to bring. The locator uses office profiles, opening hours and expert availability; the booking attaches the household's simulation, certificate or uploaded proposal so the expert is prepared, and sends reminders by e-mail and SMS. No-show rate and appointment-to-file conversion are franchise KPIs, so the brick also handles rescheduling, cancellations and the rebooking of missed appointments by customer care.
